slugify(text) lowercases text, replaces every run of characters that are not ASCII letters or digits with a single hyphen, and removes hyphens from both ends. A letter outside ASCII is not a letter here: a run of them becomes a hyphen like any other run. Examples are Python. slugify('Hello World') is 'hello-world'. slugify('  A--b  ') is 'a-b'. slugify('x') is 'x'. slugify('!!!') is ''. slugify('café') is 'caf'. slugify('naïve') is 'na-ve'.
